name: @illyism/transcribe
description: CLI tool to transcribe audio/video files to SRT format using OpenAI Whisper API

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external openai --external @clack/prompts --external pixel-react --external react --external react-reconciler && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external openai && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.tui:engine: cd ref/terminal-browser/engine/packages/pixel-react && bun run build:native && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build

author: Ilias Ismanalijev
